strengths_deep_dive: Muhsen effectively builds organizational capacity across local communities to serve individuals with special needs. By supporting <cite id="3">15 active weekend schools</cite> and training <cite id="4">502 volunteers</cite>, the charity fills an underserved niche within the community [3][4]. It maintains a low cost of fundraising, spending <cite id="15">$0.07 per $1 raised</cite>, allowing the vast majority of public contributions to directly fund operational programs [15].
rich_narrative.summary: Muhsen aims to establish inclusive spaces for children and adults with intellectual, mental, or physical disabilities across North America [3]. The organization works directly with local institutions to offer <cite id="3">masjid certification, service certification, respite care, and weekend school programs</cite>. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="15">Total Revenue of $3,305,007</cite>. However, its operational allocation shows a <cite id="15">Program expense ratio of 57.4%</cite>, which falls below the sector benchmark of 75%. On fundraising efficiency, the organization excels by <cite id="15">spending only $0.07 per $1 raised</cite>. The charity is <cite id="2">Zakat-eligible</cite>, assisting eligible families who require specialized support services [2]. While program growth remains strong, the organization holds significant liquidity, maintaining over 35 months of operating reserves [15].
